name: Fiji Citizenship by Naturalisation (Citizenship of Fiji Act 2009, as amended by the Citizenship of Fiji (Amendment) Act 2026)

requirements.blocker_text: Lawfully present in Fiji for 8 of the preceding 10 years; good character; intent to continue residing in Fiji; adequate English and civic knowledge. The Minister must grant if conditions are met and must refuse if not -- a mandatory, non-discretionary decision once eligibility is established.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 8 years of lawful presence within a 10-year window.

requirements.blocker_text: Same 8-of-10-year lawful presence, good character, English/civic knowledge test, PLUS -- from 1 January 2035 onward -- must hold a valid Permanent Residence Permit at time of application, formally tying naturalisation to the PR system.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 8 years of lawful presence within a 10-year window and hold a valid PR permit.

evidence_required.document: Proof of lawful presence 8 of the preceding 10 years
English language and civic knowledge test
Valid Permanent Residence Permit (required only from 1 January 2035)

sources.title: Parliament of Fiji -- Citizenship of Fiji (Amendment) Act 2026 (Act No. 10 of 2026): introduces a transitional naturalisation regime running to 1 January 2035 (8 of preceding 10 years lawful presence, good character, English/civic knowledge, mandatory grant/refusal), after which a valid Permanent Residence Permit becomes an additional precondition; also waives the naturalisation application fee for 5 years for members of the Banaban community

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Fiji). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 sourced directly to the Act's own text on parliament.gov.fj, passed just months before this build (June 2026). MARQUEE FINDING: Fiji's naturalisation regime is mid-transition -- the 8-of-10-year rule modeled here governs until 1 January 2035, at which point holding a valid PR permit becomes an ADDITIONAL mandatory precondition (this file's two requirement_groups capture both the transitional and post-2035 states, which happen to share the same residence test but differ on the PR-permit requirement). This supersedes the PRIOR 2020 Amendment Act rule (10 of the preceding 15 years, PR permit required throughout, application lodged 3+ months before PR permit expiry) -- do not use the 2020 figures, they are no longer current. DISTINCTIVE FINDING: the 2026 Act also waives the naturalisation application fee for 5 years specifically for the Banaban community -- Pacific Islanders resettled on Rabi Island, Fiji, after WWII-era phosphate-mining displacement from Ocean Island/Banaba (Kiribati) -- a historical environmental-displacement population given a targeted, time-bounded fee concession; disclosed here as context, not modeled as a separate route since it's a fee waiver, not a distinct eligibility path.
